lines.text: &fAsk another player to let you teleport to them, or to come to you. Nothing happens until they say yes.

&7Everyone online is listed on the left; the search box above narrows it by name. Each name has two buttons &8- hover them&7: the first is &fAsk to teleport to them&7, the second &fAsk them to come to you&7.
&7They see the request in this tab and as a line in chat with &a[Accept]&7 and &c[Deny]&7 on it. Your own requests are listed under &fAsked by you&7, with &fCancel&7 to take one back.
&7A request lapses after &e2 minutes&7 if nobody answers. Asking the same player again replaces the old request.
&7Requests waiting on you are on the right under &fAsked of you&7, with &fAccept&7 and &fDeny&7.
&7If they asked to come to you, they arrive &binstantly&7 once you accept. If they asked you over, a &a3 second countdown&7 runs over your hotbar first, then you travel.
&7If the other player logs out or is gone by the time it fires, nobody is moved.
&7The &fsettings button&7 at the top sets who may send you a request: &fAnyone&7, &fMy team and allies&7, &fMy team only&7, or &fNo one&7.
&7A turned-away request is silent &8- the other player is told, you are not.
&7The two team settings need &fFTB Teams&7 on the server; without it they let nobody through.
&fRandom&7 drops you at a random safe spot in the world. Finding one can take a moment, then a &a3 second countdown&7 runs. It has a cooldown, which starts only once you arrive.
&fBack&7 returns you to where you were before your last teleport, or to where you died, after a &a3 second countdown&7.
&fSpawn&7 takes you to the world spawn &binstantly&7.
